card.name: Punctuation before a relative's name
card.fires_on: Commas, 'and', or family words like daughter, sister, wife right before a named woman in a biography, mostly 19th-century American figures. It sits where a first name (Harriet, Mary, Livy, Jane) is expected next.

modes.label: Comma before a name
modes.description: A comma or period right before a person's first name in a family or biographical passage.
modes.example: asking her uncle Robert Mean’s widow<<,>> Abigail Kent Means, to perform the

modes.label: Family word before name
modes.description: A relation word like daughter, sister or wife just before the relative's name.
modes.example: Death: Jane Pierce died at her<< sister>> Mary Aiken’s home in Andover

modes.label: Joining word in name lists
modes.description: The word 'and' linking two named people.
modes.example: settlement workers Lillian Wald<< and>> Jane Addams helped found the WTUL

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are a mix of name pieces and unrelated fragments.
card.plain: It fires just before a personal name is about to appear in a historical biography, such as after a comma or a word like sister or wife.
